subject.title: fix(reef): add timeout and bounded JSON reads to relay transport

question: Is a fixed 15-second deadline acceptable for every Reef relay HTTP request handled by `ReefTransportClient.request`?
rationale: The timeout prevents an indefinite channel stall but intentionally converts slow relay responses into failures, and the repository does not expose an existing Reef timeout contract that settles the threshold automatically.

options.title: Accept the 15-second contract
options.body: Merge the focused patch with 15 seconds as the Reef-owned request deadline, relying on the existing reconnect path for stalled or slow relays.

options.title: Calibrate the deadline first
options.body: Adjust the constant or narrow its application after checking expected relay latency for authentication, friend, mail pull, send, and acknowledgment operations.

recommendation.title: Accept the 15-second contract
recommendation.body: Merge the focused patch with 15 seconds as the Reef-owned request deadline, relying on the existing reconnect path for stalled or slow relays.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the same Reef relay request boundary and its failure-handling tests.
